subject: Lighthouse: MAP & implementation commitments
messages:
From: Eli Thompson <eli@lighthouseanalytics.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: MAP and milestone commitments for Redwood evaluation

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the engineering + product teams were impressed with the latency profiles and cost levers. We want to put together a short mutual action plan so our Legal/Procurement and Engineering teams have a clear timeline and owners.

Can you share a draft MAP that includes: milestone dates (POC -> pilot -> production), the Redwood owners and Lighthouse owners for each milestone, acceptance criteria for the pilot, and any compliance artifacts we should expect (SOC2, data handling notes)?

Procurement also asked for a simple implementation timeline they can include in their review packet. We’d like the draft by EOD Friday if possible.

Attaching our internal requirements doc.

Thanks,
Eli
Eli Thompson
Head of Integrations, Lighthouse Analytics
[attachment: lighthouse_requirements_v2.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Eli Thompson <eli@lighthouseanalytics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: MAP and milestone commitments for Redwood evaluation

Eli — appreciate the clear ask.

Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan and a compact implementation register (Lighthouse_MAP_v1.xlsx). High level items included below — please review and flag anything you want shifted:

- POC window (integration + perf validation): Jul 26 – Aug 9 — Owner: Lighthouse Eng (Eli), Redwood SE (Karthik)
- Pilot (end-to-end feature gating, limited production traffic): Aug 10 – Sep 6 — Owner: Lighthouse PM (Olivia), Redwood CS (Monica)
- Production launch (full traffic, SLA handover): Sep 20 — Owner: Lighthouse Ops, Redwood Platform (ops lead cc’d on final runbook)

Acceptance criteria (pilot):
- < 120ms P95 for 99% of generation calls under canonical workload
- End-to-end request/response traces visible in Redwood Console and shared with Lighthouse (first 2 weeks)
- No PII in payloads or confirmed transformation agreed in data-flow doc

Compliance artifacts included in the sheet and the Drive link below. I’ve noted SOC2 evidence (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf) as available on request; Monica will coordinate access.

Next steps: can you confirm owners/dates by tomorrow so we can lock the MAP and send to your procurement team?

Attachments: Lighthouse_MAP_v1.xlsx, data_flow_diagram.png

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0183
[attachment: Lighthouse_MAP_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Eli Thompson <eli@lighthouseanalytics.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: MAP and milestone commitments for Redwood evaluation

Thanks — looping in a few CS details so we have acceptance checkboxes:

Monica’s CS kickoff plan (detailed):
- Week 0 (Aug 10): Kickoff call, access provisioning, shared Slack channel, and runbook handoff. Deliverables: test account, example prompts, and canonical dataset slice for perf tests.
- Week 1–2 (Aug 10–Aug 24): Integration verification and tokenization checks. CS will run ~3 smoke suites.
- Week 3 (Aug 24–Sep 6): Regression and load ramp tests; finalize A/B routing plan.

Acceptance/exit criteria for pilot (CS):
- Successful completion of smoke suites with documented failures < 3 items and mitigations logged.
- Shared dashboard with latency/cost-by-route.
- Signed off runbook with rollback plan.

I’ll also prepare the SOC2 access summary and provide a short walk-through with your security lead — drop me proposed times and I’ll schedule.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@lighthouseanalytics.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@lighthouseanalytics.com, Eli Thompson <eli@lighthouseanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: MAP and milestone commitments for Redwood evaluation

Hi team — procurement here. A couple of constraints from our side that will shift a few target dates:

- Our procurement review cycle will not complete before Aug 12 (we need two weeks for legal review + external security okay). That means the POC can proceed with dev keys and a data sandbox but full pilot traffic can only start after contract signature. Suggest we treat Aug 10–Aug 24 as an "integration-only" POC and move the pilot start to Aug 16 and extend pilot window by two weeks.
- We need the SOC2 summary and evidence by EOD Tue so our security can triage before the legal review.
- Please confirm that API keys will be issued with least-privilege access and a 30-day rotation policy (we enforce this internally).

I’ve attached our procurement checklist for your reference. If you can update the MAP and timeline accordingly, we’ll aim to have sign-off before Aug 12.

Thanks,
Olivia Park
VP, Product Operations | Lighthouse Analytics
[attachment: procurement_checklist.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia@lighthouseanalytics.com>, Eli Thompson <eli@lighthouseanalytics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: MAP and milestone commitments for Redwood evaluation

Olivia / Eli — thanks for the clarifications. Per procurement requests we updated the MAP and acceptance dates. Summary of changes and immediate asks below: 

- POC (integration-only, dev keys): Jul 26 – Aug 15 — Redwood will provide sandbox credentials scoped to non-production endpoints. Owner: Karthik (SE) and Lighthouse Eng.
- Pilot (contract signed, limited production traffic): Aug 16 – Sep 20 — Owner: Lighthouse PM (Olivia) & Redwood CS (Monica). We extended pilot by two weeks to accommodate procurement gating.
- Production launch target: Sep 24 — subject to successful pilot sign-off and legal countersignature.

Immediate asks: 
1) Olivia — confirm security contact and a preferred time for SOC2 walk-through tomorrow (Tue).
2) Eli — confirm Lighthouse acceptance of the revised pilot window by EOD tomorrow so I can update Legal and circulate the final MAP.

Links: Drive (MAP and artifacts) — https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cLighthouseMAP
HubSpot: HS-124578

Attaching updated MAP register (same filename). Once we have a confirmed owner list I’ll send a final copy with sign-off lines.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[attachment: Lighthouse_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated)]
